GET /plugin-api/nutanix/status.note: Returns Nutanix cluster, host, storage, and VM inventory or an unconfigured payload when settings are empty

GET /plugin-api/nutanix/vms.note: Lists discovered Nutanix VMs matched against Termix hosts

POST /plugin-api/nutanix/vms/:uuid/power.note: Power action requires a live Nutanix Prism Central appliance; verifies auth and RBAC refusal paths

POST /plugin-api/nutanix/import-vms.note: VM import requires a live Nutanix Prism Central appliance; verifies auth and RBAC refusal paths
